later_source_review.head: 4dba8b9b516cccfda369d582396d4210f942df9f
later_source_review.scope: Separate source fixes/review, not the measured b579 OVA. These captures neither qualify the newer artifact nor close its full-disk/scanner/sidecar validation requirements.

production_blocker_disposition: Unchanged: the 120-second repeated recovery gate failed; other authoritative appliance readiness blockers are not closed or accepted by this experiment. A rebuilt integrated artifact requires separate qualification.
preserved_failures: E0 repeatability failed; earlier 128/1024 rootfs-udev comparison failed.
V3 experiment invalid: hook refused reason=root; builtin dmesg format failure retained.
V4 builtin dmesg raw/color mutual exclusion retained separately; supplemental evidence proves valid actual hook.
V4 B1 FAIL165.781 seconds and returnA1 FAIL132.453 seconds remain FAIL despite backup/PONG/persistence PASS.
ReturnA1 unit_logs capture timed out at15seconds with exit-9 and zero bytes; daemon pre-log durations unknown.
Historical597-second recovery and10-second backup timeout remain unresolved.
conclusions: Valid pre-root application is demonstrated on all five measured boots. The required three-consecutive-B timing gate nevertheless fails (FAIL/PASS/PASS).
Containerd pre-log improves on B2/B3 but not B1; returnA1 pre-log is unknown due collector timeout. This does not establish a clean reversible binary-load effect.
B1 coincides with materially heavier shared-device writes/queueing. Device counters include unrelated workloads and20second aggregation; no causal storage claim.
VM CPU ready remains low relative to20second intervals with zero observed co-stop/max-limited/balloon/swap-in. This is not proof of absence of every host scheduling confound.
Clock-correlated acceptance-to-next-boot windows differ substantially; they do not isolate shutdown from firmware/early kernel transition.
Do not equate systemd unit completion or first sampled PONG with authenticated three-sample ready/traffic/ClamAV acceptance.

Final original-initrd boot passes97.515seconds; original bytes/hash and128KiB effective value are verified and experiment marker is absent. This restores the original boot image without converting earlier timing failures to passes.
